name: OpenShift / Kubernetes
credentialWhere: User Management → ServiceAccounts in the web console
credentialNote: One connection per cluster; --env and --instance pick it by its env and instance settings

supported.api: core v1, apps/v1, apps.openshift.io/v1 and metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1
supported.note: pod list, event list and pod logs use core v1; deployment list uses apps/v1, or apps.openshift.io/v1 for DeploymentConfigs; pod metrics and namespace usage need metrics-server (metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1). No release has been verified yet.
